file_layout.note: Each test file holds its inputs and its answers together. The answer for a record lives under the record's "evaluation" key. Module 1 preserves unknown keys, so these files ingest unchanged.
file_layout.label_type: complete list of capabilities assigned by a human auditor, with no primary or secondary distinction. Score set precision and set recall per capability.
file_layout.selected_for: Test 1 only. Records which class the row was chosen to balance the corpus by. It is not a label and must not be scored.
